author: Akosa Samuel Onyejekwe (independent)
title: Prediction of Dynamic Stall on a Pitching NACA 0012 Section
solver: UNISTALL, a Leishman-Beddoes dynamic-stall load model with tabulated separation (Python package unistall)
method: Leishman-Beddoes indicial method with a tabulated separation point

A_validation.label: Case A: tunnel condition
A_validation.description: tunnel condition of NASA TM-84245, frame 9302

B_application.label: Case B: rotor-blade-station condition
B_application.description: an aerofoil at a rotor-blade-station condition (steady stream, prescribed pitch); not a rotor calculation

field_reconstruction.what_it_is: Potential-flow reconstruction drawn round the predicted lift, not a flow solution: incompressible, with a linearised (Karman-Tsien) correction of the pressure that holds only where the local flow is subcritical, and quasi-steady (no shed wake, no pitch-rate boundary condition, no unsteady pressure term, vortex not force-free); no boundary layer, no separated shear layer. A transpiration through the suction surface, of either sign, stands for the separated region, which is not drawn: no reversed flow and no wake appear. The vortex is a marker of the model's vortex clock and does not reproduce a suction footprint. Compared with no measurement; no load depends on it.

read_by_the_driver.note: 04_solver/run_case.py passes these four to unistall.flowfield; changing one here changes the output

record_of_module_constants.note: a record of the constants of unistall.flowfield at the time of writing; the driver does not read them, and a check asserts that they still equal the module's
record_of_module_constants.panels: straight panels, each with a source of constant strength and a vortex sheet of one uniform strength, velocities from the closed-form panel integrals

transpiration.what: an equivalent transpiration through the suction surface standing for the separated region: an outflow where positive, an inflow where negative; its strength is solved so that the Kutta condition holds at the trailing edge while the circulation stays that of the predicted lift
transpiration.wall_condition: v_n = v_t w on the suction-surface panels aft of x/c = min(f_sep, 1 - attached_outflow_fraction); w a smooth step from 0 there to 1 at the trailing edge
transpiration.kutta_condition: equal pressure at the two control points next to the trailing edge

compressibility.what: a linearised correction applied to an incompressible reconstruction, valid only where the local flow is subcritical; not a compressible solution
compressibility.pressure: Karman-Tsien correction of the incompressible Cp at the stream Mach number: Cp_c = Cp / (beta + M^2 Cp / (2 (1 + beta))), beta = sqrt(1 - M^2)
compressibility.vacuum_cap_note: the corrected Cp is not allowed below this fraction of the vacuum value -2/(gamma M^2) (cases.<case>.critical.Cp_vacuum)
compressibility.beyond_critical: where the corrected Cp is below cases.<case>.critical.Cp_critical the local Mach number is above one, the correction does not hold and the values are not physical; those points are flagged, hatched in the figures and counted
compressibility.local_state: local Mach number, static temperature and recovery temperature from the corrected Cp by the isentropic relations with the stagnation state of the stream
compressibility.recovery_factor_source: Pr^(1/3), the usual value for a turbulent boundary layer on a flat plate, with Pr = 0.72 for air
compressibility.circulation: the sheet carries the fraction of the circulation of the lift at which the corrected surface pressure returns the lift given; the fraction is solved at each instant, starting from the Prandtl-Glauert factor sqrt(1 - M^2)

field_files.format: gzip-compressed CSV, one row per grid node
field_files.beyond_critical: 1 where the corrected Cp is below the critical value: Cp, Mach and the temperatures are not physical there; 0 elsewhere
field_files.inside: 1 at a node inside the section, where the values are those of the singularities and have no physical meaning; 0 elsewhere

field_reconstruction.bound_circulation: Gamma = 0.5 CL U c, uniform vortex sheet on the surface

vortex.what: a marker of the load model's vortex clock; it does not reproduce a suction footprint
vortex.position: x/c = x0 + dx tau, y/c = y0 + dy tau, tau = tau_v / Tvl; over the trailing edge at tau = 1
vortex.path_and_core: assumed: chosen for illustration, neither derived nor measured

field_phases.rise: upstroke, mean incidence plus half the amplitude
field_phases.dsv: instant of greatest vortex normal force
field_phases.fall: downstroke, mean incidence plus half the amplitude
